entries.run_command:
# See artifact for build instructions. Requires built httpd.
# apxs -c -i mod_test_again.c
# httpd -X -f test_config.conf
# curl http://localhost:8080/test
entries.expected_signal: OK+CONN_STATE_PROCESSING should trigger lingering close (connection closed); AGAIN+CONN_STATE_PROCESSING should keep connection alive for I/O wait
entries.reachability_signal: GCOV shows coverage on process_socket() lines 1142-1160 (switch/case for AGAIN handling)
entries.input_strategy: Generate HTTP requests to trigger process_connection hook with different return codes and connection states
entries.contract_probe: return_contract_stability: compare connection close behavior between old (OK -> POLLIN/POLLOUT) and new (OK -> lingering_close, AGAIN -> POLLIN/POLLOUT) contracts
prerequisites: patched httpd binary built with event MPM and GCOV
apxs tool available for module compilation
limitations: Requires running httpd instance with event MPM configured
GCOV data collection needs httpd graceful restart or shutdown
Test module must be carefully written to correctly set cs->state and return appropriate codes

entries.run_command:
See artifact for build and execution instructions. Requires httpd with mod_http2 + nghttp2.
# Build: configure --enable-http2 --with-nghttp2=/path && make
# Run: httpd -X -f h2_test.conf
# Test: curl --http2 -k https://localhost:8443/test
entries.expected_signal: h2_c1_run returns AGAIN when MPM supports AP_MPMQ_CAN_AGAIN; clogging_input_filters=1 when not
entries.reachability_signal: GCOV shows coverage on h2_c1_run() lines 155-190 (AGAIN/clogging branch) and lines 305-311 (return propagation)
entries.input_strategy: HTTP/2 requests triggering h2_send_flow_blocked to return to MPM monitoring; test with and without AP_MPMQ_CAN_AGAIN capable MPM
entries.contract_probe: return_contract_stability: verify h2_c1_run return value propagates correctly through h2_c1_hook_process_connection to MPM
prerequisites: patched httpd binary built with event MPM, mod_http2, mod_ssl, GCOV
limitations: mod_http2 only works with event MPM (which supports AP_MPMQ_CAN_AGAIN in this patch)
Full HTTP/2 session lifecycle may be complex to trigger specific flow-blocked conditions
clogging_input_filters fallback path only triggered on MPMs without AP_MPMQ_CAN_AGAIN
